problems.title: AI-Powered Token Optimization System
problems.description: Large Language Models consume excessive tokens because of lengthy prompts, redundant instructions and unnecessary context, increasing API costs and response times.
problems.challenge: Develop an AI-powered system that optimizes prompts, removes redundant content and compresses context to reduce token consumption while maintaining response accuracy, relevance and quality.
problems.summary: Large Language Models consume excessive tokens because of lengthy prompts, redundant instructions and unnecessary context, increasing API costs and response times.

problems.title: Intelligent Employee and Project Allocation System
problems.description: IT organizations often have employees on the bench because of project releases, budget constraints and mismatches between employee skills and available project requirements.
problems.challenge: Develop an intelligent platform that matches employees with suitable projects based on their technical skills, experience, availability and career interests.
problems.summary: IT organizations often have employees on the bench because of project releases, budget constraints and mismatches between employee skills and available project requirements.

problems.title: Unified Social Media Publishing and Management Platform
problems.description: Small businesses and retail owners struggle to manage promotional content across multiple social media platforms. Creating and publishing posts separately is repetitive and time-consuming.
problems.challenge: Develop a centralized platform that enables business owners to create, manage and publish promotional content across multiple social media platforms through a single interface.
problems.summary: Small businesses and retail owners struggle to manage promotional content across multiple social media platforms. Creating and publishing posts separately is repetitive and time-consuming.

problems.title: Smart Inventory and Stock Management System
problems.description: Small retail businesses frequently depend on manual registers and spreadsheets, making it difficult to maintain accurate stock records and monitor product movement.
problems.challenge: Develop a digital inventory management system that tracks products, stock quantities and transactions using unique product IDs, QR codes or barcodes.
problems.summary: Small retail businesses frequently depend on manual registers and spreadsheets, making it difficult to maintain accurate stock records and monitor product movement.

problems.title: AI-Powered Proactive Customer Follow-Up and Assistance Agent
problems.description: Organizations such as hospitals, automobile dealerships and service providers often depend on customers to initiate contact, resulting in missed maintenance schedules and delayed follow-ups.
problems.challenge: Develop an AI-powered voice agent that automatically initiates customer calls, understands responses through natural conversations and performs appropriate follow-up actions.
problems.summary: Organizations such as hospitals, automobile dealerships and service providers often depend on customers to initiate contact, resulting in missed maintenance schedules and delayed follow-ups.

problems.title: AI-Based Customer Issue Prioritization and Management
problems.description: Customer support teams receive numerous complaints and service requests. Manually identifying urgent issues and assigning them to appropriate teams can delay resolution.
problems.challenge: Develop an intelligent system that categorizes customer complaints by severity and business impact, detects duplicate complaints and recommends the appropriate resolution teams.
problems.summary: Customer support teams receive numerous complaints and service requests. Manually identifying urgent issues and assigning them to appropriate teams can delay resolution.

problems.title: Predictive Cloud Cost Optimization
problems.description: Organizations experience unnecessary cloud expenditure because of unused resources, inefficient resource allocation and unexpected increases in infrastructure usage.
problems.challenge: Develop a platform that analyzes cloud resource utilization and spending patterns, predicts future expenses and recommends cost-saving opportunities without compromising performance.
problems.summary: Organizations experience unnecessary cloud expenditure because of unused resources, inefficient resource allocation and unexpected increases in infrastructure usage.

problems.title: Automated Software Release Risk Assessment
problems.description: Software updates can introduce unexpected errors and affect existing application functionality. Identifying deployment risks requires analyzing code changes, test results and historical defects.
problems.challenge: Develop an intelligent system that evaluates software release risks using code changes, test coverage, historical defects and affected application components to predict potential deployment issues.
problems.summary: Software updates can introduce unexpected errors and affect existing application functionality. Identifying deployment risks requires analyzing code changes, test results and historical defects.

problems.title: AI-Powered Network Health Monitoring and Outage Prediction
problems.description: Network failures, unusual traffic patterns and infrastructure performance issues can disrupt organizational operations. Identifying potential failures before outages occur is challenging.
problems.challenge: Develop an AI-powered network monitoring system that analyzes network traffic, device events and resource utilization to detect anomalies, predict potential failures and recommend corrective actions.
problems.summary: Network failures, unusual traffic patterns and infrastructure performance issues can disrupt organizational operations. Identifying potential failures before outages occur is challenging.

problems.title: Recourse, Not Rejection: AI-Based Decision Transparency
problems.description: AI systems are increasingly used for loan approvals, recruitment and employee evaluations. However, individuals receiving negative decisions often lack explanations or guidance on how to improve their outcomes.
problems.challenge: Develop an AI-powered system that explains negative machine learning decisions, recommends realistic changes to improve outcomes and evaluates whether those recommendations are equally achievable across different groups.
problems.summary: AI systems are increasingly used for loan approvals, recruitment and employee evaluations. However, individuals receiving negative decisions often lack explanations or guidance on how to improve their outcomes.

problems.title: Aquifer Commons: Smart Groundwater Management System
problems.description: Farmers sharing groundwater resources often pump water independently, making it difficult to monitor total consumption and ensure fair distribution, resulting in excessive groundwater extraction.
problems.challenge: Develop a low-cost system that estimates borewell water usage without expensive flow meters, monitors village-level consumption and calculates fair water allocation among farmers.
problems.summary: Farmers sharing groundwater resources often pump water independently, making it difficult to monitor total consumption and ensure fair distribution, resulting in excessive groundwater extraction.

problems.title: Is This Screenshot Real? AI-Based Screenshot Verification System
problems.description: Screenshots of conversations, online payments and bank messages are frequently used as evidence, but they can be manipulated using image-editing applications and fake screenshot generators.
problems.challenge: Develop an intelligent verification system that analyzes screenshots to identify potential manipulations, highlights suspicious regions and generates reports explaining why the evidence may be unreliable.
problems.summary: Screenshots of conversations, online payments and bank messages are frequently used as evidence, but they can be manipulated using image-editing applications and fake screenshot generators.

problems.title: Remix Lineage: Digital Content Tracking and Attribution System
problems.description: Content creators frequently face unauthorized copying and redistribution of their videos. Modified versions involving cropping, mirroring and editing make identifying original sources difficult.
problems.challenge: Develop a system that identifies original video sources, detects modified versions and establishes relationships between copies. The system should also suggest fair credit attribution or revenue distribution.
problems.summary: Content creators frequently face unauthorized copying and redistribution of their videos. Modified versions involving cropping, mirroring and editing make identifying original sources difficult.

problems.title: Ghost Routes: Informal Public Transport Route Discovery
problems.description: Informal transport services such as shared autos, private minibuses and local jeeps often operate without officially documented routes or schedules, making them difficult to discover through navigation applications.
problems.challenge: Develop a system that uses anonymous commuter GPS data to identify commonly used routes and stops, estimate service frequency and display discovered routes on an interactive map.
problems.summary: Informal transport services such as shared autos, private minibuses and local jeeps often operate without officially documented routes or schedules, making them difficult to discover through navigation applications.

problems.title: The Retiring Technician: AI-Based Industrial Knowledge Management System
problems.description: Experienced factory technicians possess valuable machine repair knowledge that is often undocumented and lost when employees retire. Existing manuals may not contain practical troubleshooting solutions.
problems.challenge: Develop an AI-powered knowledge management system that captures technicians' spoken repair explanations, connects them with machine fault records and converts them into searchable troubleshooting guides.
problems.summary: Experienced factory technicians possess valuable machine repair knowledge that is often undocumented and lost when employees retire. Existing manuals may not contain practical troubleshooting solutions.

problems.title: Returns That Never Go Home: Intelligent E-Commerce Return Management System
problems.description: Returned e-commerce products are generally transported back to central warehouses, even when nearby customers are waiting for the same products. This increases transportation costs and delivery time.
problems.challenge: Develop an intelligent return management system that determines whether returned products should go to a warehouse, nearby hub or directly to another customer based on product condition, nearby orders, delivery requirements and potential fraud.
problems.summary: Returned e-commerce products are generally transported back to central warehouses, even when nearby customers are waiting for the same products. This increases transportation costs and delivery time.

problems.title: The Building That Reads the Tariff: Smart Building Energy Optimization System
problems.description: Commercial buildings often waste electricity because cooling systems operate on fixed schedules regardless of room occupancy. Electricity tariffs also vary during peak and off-peak hours.
problems.challenge: Develop an intelligent energy management system that estimates room or floor occupancy using Wi-Fi connections, access-card records and meeting schedules, then optimizes cooling schedules based on occupancy, electricity tariffs and temperature patterns while maintaining occupant comfort.
problems.summary: Commercial buildings often waste electricity because cooling systems operate on fixed schedules regardless of room occupancy. Electricity tariffs also vary during peak and off-peak hours.
